content: megajs 1.3.10 (MIT) is the maintained unofficial Mega.nz JS SDK. Works in browser via the browser build (browser-native crypto, not crypto-browserify which bloats bundle). Storage class with email/password login (.upload, files tree); File.fromURL for shared links. Set userAgent to null in browser. Mega is end-to-end encrypted. Free-tier transfer quota throttling applies (logged-in raises limits). No official Mega browser SDK exists; megajs is the de-facto choice.
